Test move declaration refactoring: updating references across source, destination, and other packages.

{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --
{
	"moveDeclaration": true
}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs

go 1.20

-- dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

-- dest2/dest2.go --
package dest2

func Existing() {}

-- src/in_src.go --
package src

func TargetInSrc() int { //@codeaction(re"TargetInSrc", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest2/dest2.go"}`, result=ref_in_src)
	return 42
}

func CallerSameFile() int {
	return TargetInSrc()
}

-- @ref_in_src/dest2/dest2.go --
package dest2

func Existing() {}

func TargetInSrc() int {
	return 42
}
-- @ref_in_src/src/in_src.go --
package src

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/dest2"

func TargetInSrc() int { //@codeaction(re"TargetInSrc", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest2/dest2.go"}`, result=ref_in_src)
	return 42
}

func CallerSameFile() int {
	return dest2.TargetInSrc()
}

-- src/to_dest.go --
package src

func MoveToDest() int { //@codeaction(re"MoveToDest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=ref_in_dest)
	return 7
}

-- @ref_in_dest/dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

func MoveToDest() int {
	return 7
}
-- @ref_in_dest/dest/use_src.go --
package dest



func UseFromDest() int {
	return MoveToDest()
}

-- dest/use_src.go --
package dest

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/src"

func UseFromDest() int {
	return src.MoveToDest()
}

-- src/to_ext.go --
package src

func StayInSrc() int {
	return 1
}

func MoveForExtOnly() int { //@codeaction(re"MoveForExtOnly", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=ref_in_ext_drop_src)
	return 2
}

func MoveForExtShared() int { //@codeaction(re"MoveForExtShared", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=ref_in_ext_keep_src)
	return 3
}

-- @ref_in_ext_drop_src/dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

func MoveForExtOnly() int {
	return 2
}
-- @ref_in_ext_drop_src/ext/only_moving.go --
package ext

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/dest"



func UseOnlyMoving() int {
	return dest.MoveForExtOnly()
}

-- @ref_in_ext_keep_src/dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

func MoveForExtShared() int {
	return 3
}
-- @ref_in_ext_keep_src/ext/shared_src.go --
package ext

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/dest"

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/src"

func UseBoth() int {
	return dest.MoveForExtShared() + src.StayInSrc()
}

-- ext/only_moving.go --
package ext

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/src"

func UseOnlyMoving() int {
	return src.MoveForExtOnly()
}

-- ext/shared_src.go --
package ext

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/src"

func UseBoth() int {
	return src.MoveForExtShared() + src.StayInSrc()
}

-- src/type_method.go --
package src

type Counter struct { //@codeaction(re"Counter", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest2/dest2.go"}`, result=ref_type_method)
	Val int
}

func (c *Counter) Inc() {
	c.Val++
}

func UseCounterInSrc() {
	var c Counter
	c.Inc()
}
-- @ref_type_method/dest2/dest2.go --
package dest2

func Existing() {}

type Counter struct {
	Val int
}

func (c *Counter) Inc() {
	c.Val++
}
-- @ref_type_method/src/type_method.go --
package src

import "golang.org/lsptests/movedeclrefs/dest2"

type Counter struct { //@codeaction(re"Counter", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest2/dest2.go"}`, result=ref_type_method)
	Val int
}

func (c *Counter) Inc() {
	c.Val++
}

func UseCounterInSrc() {
	var c dest2.Counter
	c.Inc()
}
